text:
Ethan Gomez: FYI Velaro (beta applicant) emailed asking to join the preview earlier than their scheduled slot. they have a strict go-live window in two weeks.
Priya Rao: do we have available seats in the current wave? I thought wave 3 was full.
Liam O'Connor: wave 3 is at capacity but we can consider a fast-track if they pass the onboarding checklist quickly. what's their use case?
Ethan Gomez: payments reconciliation + internal docs search. low QPS but sensitive PII. they requested live keys and SSO. worried about compliance timeline.
Nina Torres: sensitive data + SSO = requires Private mode signoff or clear data retention controls. we can do hosted with strict retention settings if infra approves.
Priya Rao: can we surface the exact blockers to the product team? quick triage: 
- SSO config readiness
- Data retention policy (30d vs 90d)
- DLP masking for embeddings
- Reserved seats and rate limits
Liam O'Connor: I can run through the onboarding checklist with them on a 30m call and capture any config gaps. who owns legal/data approvals?
Nina Torres: I'll loop in security-approvals@redwood for expedited review. pinging them adds ~24-48h. recommend we prepare a mitigations doc for hosted preview.
Ethan Gomez: proposed next steps: 1) schedule enablement call today, 2) send baseline data/security questionnaire, 3) capture feedback in the preview-feedback form.
Priya Rao: link to our questionnaire: https://redwood.app/preview-sec-q?cust=velaro
Liam O'Connor: scheduling now. Proposed time 4:00pm PT today (30m).
CSBot: Reminder: Scheduled event "Velaro fast-track onboarding" created by Liam O'Connor at 2025-05-02 16:00 PT.
Ethan Gomez: on the call we'll ask Velaro to confirm one admin who can toggle SSO settings and share a sample anonymized document for embedding tests.
Priya Rao: for embeddings, add this note to the checklist: client must consent to model evaluation and masking.
Liam O'Connor: added a short diagnostic command to verify token scopes during SSO: 
```
http POST https://auth.velaro.com/oauth/token grant_type=client_credentials client_id=REDACTED
```
Nina Torres: if they need a temporary seat bump, we can grant +2 seats for 72h. Oli (PM) approved emergency demo seats earlier. Priya, flag renewal risk if they ask permanent extra seats pre-contract.
Priya Rao: noted. I'll track renewal risk on the account page and set an alert.
Ethan Gomez: i'll send the invite + pre-call questionnaire link now. everyone, react with :eyes: if you want the meeting notes afterward.
Liam O'Connor: :eyes:
Priya Rao: :eyes:
Nina Torres: :eyes:
Ethan Gomez: thanks — i'll post meeting notes and the feedback form results in this thread after the call.
